title: IncrementalClassificationKernel Predict
text: Classify observations using incremental kernel classification model, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Score data type} sets Data type of score output Inherit:; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental kernel classification model, {Add output port for predicted class scores} adds second output port for predicted class, {Add output port for status of trained machine learning model} adds third output port for model status, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Kernel data type} sets the kernel computation data type, {Kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum kernel computation value for range checking, {Kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum kernel computation value for range checking, {Inner product data type} sets the inner product term of the predicted response, {Inner product data type Minimum} sets the minimum of inner product term for range checking and {Inner product data type Maximum} sets the maximum of inner product term for range checking. Values come from the instance.
